sloka: करेणु मातन्ग रथ अश्व सम्कुलम् ।महा जन ओघैः परिपूर्ण चत्वरम् ।पभूतरत्नम् बहुपण्यसम्चयम् ।ददर्श रामो विमलम् महापथम् ॥२-१६-४७॥
transliteration: kareṇu mātanga ratha aśva samkulam ।mahā jana oghaiḥ paripūrṇa catvaram ।pabhūtaratnam bahupaṇyasamcayam ।dadarśa rāmo vimalam mahāpatham ॥2-16-47॥

translations.english: With bards, panegyrists and great musical performers invoking blessings and walking ahead, he (Rama) proceeded, like Kubera amid intoxicated elephants and horses.
